description: Use when the user asks what a fund bought or sold, how a 13F filer changed its holdings, or which institutions opened/added/trimmed/exited a position. Returns quarter-over-quarter deltas, newest first; `filer`, `change_type`, `min_value_usd`, `days` narrow. Each row carries as_of_quarter_end, filed_date, lag_days, value_usd (whole dollars), cusip, issuer_name and its source filing_url; ticker is null (never guessed). Caveat: the delta is the product, not a trading edge — see the instructions and each response's `coverage` note for the universe and CIK scope.

change_type.description: Only this kind of quarter-over-quarter change

days.description: Only changes filed within the last N days.

filer.description: Filter to one fund by name substring (case-insensitive, e.g. 'Berkshire') or exact filer CIK

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

min_value_usd.description: Only positions at or above this current value in WHOLE US dollars

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

name: fund_position_changes
title: Hedge-fund / institutional position changes (SEC 13F, quarter-over-quarter)
